brief.text: Real estate and healthcare names dominate today's activity, with real estate firms STWD, NXRT, and HPP all logging cluster buys alongside medical instrument makers like NXGL and OBIO. Six Flags Entertainment (FUN) attracted the highest total cluster volume at $24,312,320 across three insiders, while GAM saw the broadest participation with five distinct insiders contributing to its $760,290 total. Among individual transactions, Starwood Property Trust (STWD) CEO Barry S. Sternlicht made by far the largest single purchase, taking down $14,697,682 in shares.
